rows.name: FastAPI
rows.reason: FastAPI is a Python API-development framework, not the requested personal email service with an application. No service-level transfer was supplied; this does not assert that email functionality is prohibited.

rows.name: HEY
rows.reason: Native apps and family offer documented; family pricing uses hey.com addresses. Custom domains have higher, separate per-user pricing; off-the-shelf third-party clients unsupported. Subjective polish requires a trial.

rows.name: Infomaniak Mail Service
rows.reason: Infomaniak Mail Service offers domain hosting and a documented first-party Android app. Final family pricing, independent user access and platform configuration remain unverified; native implementation/polish were not audited.

rows.name: mailbox Standard with a separately selected native client
rows.reason: Mailbox Standard offers custom-domain/family hosting if a separate native client is acceptable. No first-party native app verified; family accounts bill separately. Otherwise insufficient without documented first-party support.

rows.name: Infomaniak Mail with Mail Service or kSuite
rows.reason: Infomaniak offers mobile apps and custom-domain Mail Service/kSuite. Generic-domain personal service differs; calculate mailbox charges and trial interface. Neither a flat family bundle nor desktop app should be assumed.

rows.name: Fastmail
rows.reason: Apps/custom domains/six-person Family documented: observed US Family USD 132/year, Individual USD 60/year. Downloads do not establish fully native UI, subjective polish or cutoff availability.

rows.name: iCloud+ Mail with Apple Mail
rows.reason: iCloud+ offers custom-domain mail/family sharing through Apple Mail for Apple households. Observed US entry price is $0.99/month; storage also serves other iCloud uses. Native fit depends on Apple platforms.

rows.name: Proton Mail
rows.reason: Although paid Proton plans support custom domains, Proton Mail is the service the question explicitly seeks to replace, so it does not satisfy the alternative requirement.

rows.name: Fastmail
rows.reason: Offers hosted personal email, installed apps, custom domains and a six-person family plan, directly matching the requested alternative; actual interface polish remains a trial question.

rows.name: FastAPI
rows.reason: FastAPI is a Python framework for building web APIs, not a finished personal email service or native mail application; using it would require building the product.

rows.name: Fastmail
rows.reason: Fastmail documents installed apps, custom domains and flat family pricing. Polish, app internals and question-date availability remain unknown; confirm installed applications satisfy the intended meaning of native.

rows.name: iCloud+ with Apple Mail
rows.reason: Lowest verified shortlist starting price; family sharing and Apple Mail route. Ecosystem/storage fit unknown; key custom-domain article postdates question, so historical equivalence is unestablished.

rows.name: mailbox.org with Thunderbird or Apple Mail
rows.reason: Custom-domain/family backend plus separately chosen native client; not a verified first-party native-app package. Each family account costs separately; calendar/contact integration requires care.

rows.name: Fastmail
rows.reason: Fastmail documents independent personal email, installed apps, custom domains and Family plans. Fit uses installed-application meaning of native; polish and stricter native-toolkit interpretation remain untested, not violations.

rows.name: Zoho Mail
rows.reason: Zoho offers custom-domain mail and apps at per-user pricing. No flat family plan verified; Desktop Lite is web-style. Confirm Trident native entitlement; indexed prices are not final regional quotes.

rows.name: Proton Mail
rows.reason: Proton Mail is the named starting service, not the requested alternative. Its app/custom-domain features do not resolve that scope mismatch; exclusion is unrelated to encryption or price.
